disposition_reason: Total mercury by direct AAS in 111 commercial cosmetic clay powders of ten color types from nine manufacturers on the Polish market, with descriptive statistics by clay type (Table 2) and manufacturer medians in the text.

study.design: market survey of 111 cosmetic clay products
study.origin: not stated (Rhassoul described as from Morocco)
study.method: direct thermal decomposition AAS (AMA 254), no digestion
lod: LOD 0.01 ng Hg absolute (about 0.2 µg/kg for a 50 mg portion; not stated on a mass basis)
study.qa: CRM INCT-MPH-2 Mixed Polish Herbs, 0.018 ± 0.002 mg/kg, recovery 92.22% (n = 6)
